**PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt** is a psychiatry clinic recognized for its strong performance in the treatment of adults with ADHD, particularly in the delivery of psychoeducation. Within a broader national evaluation of ADHD treatment quality—which highlighted systemic and registration challenges in regions like North Jutland and the Capital Region—this clinic emerged as a notable local success [^src1].

The clinic's primary significance in the current reporting period is its high achievement on [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]], the first quality indicator for adults with ADHD evaluated in the annual report [^src1]. PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt is one of only three departments nationwide to reach or exceed an 80% compliance rate on this metric, achieving exactly 80% [^src1]. This outlier performance places it in an elite group alongside [[psy-lokalpsykiatri-toender|PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder)]], which scored 83%, and [[pho-klinik-1-for-psykiatriske-lidelser-horsens|PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens]], which scored 82% [^src1]. Reaching this threshold underscores the clinic's strong, effective focus on psychoeducation, contributing to the broader strategic goals for improving ADHD care quality [^src1].
